properties.description: Following a synchronous reset edge, both response valid signals must be cleared; reset-edge pre observations are not prematurely cleared.
Every presented data byte must be justified by an accepted input prefix or completed-frame zero padding, and must match the ordered expected byte.
Presented data must place last exactly at the adjusted frame boundary, including minimum-length padding and maximum-length truncation.
Every presented header must correspond to the next completed input frame and report its original length, adjusted length, padding flag and truncation flag independently of data consumption.
Each independently blocked response channel must retain valid and its complete payload across clock edges, except when reset cancels it.
After 32 uninterrupted reset-low, ready-high cycles without a source offer, tracked data and header obligations must be drained, with no partial accepted input frame or remaining response valid.
